capture_retention: Native API responses and failures are retained locally; this derived public report includes their digests, not their full bodies.
limits: Release selection and path inventories are not content or license approval.
Null GitHub license metadata is unknown, not proof that a license is absent.
HTTP 404 does not establish whether a repository was removed, renamed or made private.
API recursive-tree response sha may identify the requested commit; it is not independently admitted as a Git tree object.
Old source prefixes with zero paths require layout investigation before removal.
The original observation applied no updates; the separately reviewed Playwright transaction followed it.
